item.title: Industry, Innovation, Infrastructure
item.description: Something I find interesting is the idea that growth is so often the primary indicator of success. The idea that problems go away if we have more. More anything. More everything.

item.title: Non residential wastewater
item.description:
One of the biggest opportunities for reducing the environmental footprint of primary industry exists in the handling and reduction of wastewater.

The headline example of this at the moment is probably AI datacenters; the media are describing an AI landscape where every model interaction supposedly requires a vast amount of water and electricity to cool these vast computer hubs. Water is not actually consumed in this process; however, it is considered waste because it is a vector transporter of heat, where heat is the waste product.

item.title: Constituents
item.description:
Did you know there’s a spotify playlist called “Songs About Water”?

Well, when I sat down to write this blog, I thought it might put me in the mood to write about water. And then I thought Wait, is this a common experience? This playlist has over 1k saves on Spotify, are all these people writing about water? Why are there so many songs about water? Why doesn’t the playlist contain Every Teardrop Is a Waterfall by Coldplay? Do these artists also sing about air?
